items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday practice for the first time since his injury, missing the prior three games; Rapoport confirmed same and prior expectation he plays vs Bills.
items.why: First full practice since Week 4 ankle; trending to return.
items.implication: Major boost to Ravens offense and related fantasy assets.
items.opportunity: Unlocks higher ceiling for pass-catchers and run game.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love returns to practice (Cardinals injury report).
items.why: Back on field per Wed report.
items.implication: Trending toward availability; monitor for ACTIVE.
items.opportunity: If plays, RB opportunity in ARI backfield.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle aggravated chest injury; DNP Wednesday, status for Broncos vs Chiefs TBD later this week.
items.implication: Game-time or sit risk; have backup ready.
items.opportunity: If OUT, more targets to Courtland Sutton/Pat Bryant.

items.text: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) limited in Wednesday practice, first participation since Week 4 injury; availability vs Broncos uncertain, key to monitor rest of week.
items.implication: Possible return but ramp-up; not lock.
items.opportunity: If ACTIVE, immediate WR upside in KC; else Worthy continues.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) listed as non-participant in Wednesday practice; no indication he will miss Week 8 vs Vikings, possibly precautionary/rest.
items.implication: Monitor Thu/Fri; likely plays but watch for limited.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevates backups like Vaki/Montgomery handcuff role.

items.text: Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) non-participant Wednesday after Week 7 injury; Campbell indicated likely miss Wed but availability for Vikings not in jeopardy.
items.why: Ankle from Packers game; expected fine.
items.implication: Confirm practice rest of week; high probability ACTIVE.
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT, more targets to Jameson Williams.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase non-participant Wednesday due to ankle injury and rest (NIR); expected available vs Titans if returns later in week.
items.implication: Low concern; start as usual pending Fri.
items.opportunity: If OUT unexpected, Tee Higgins and Chase Brown upside.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba ripping 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies despite losing Kubiak, limited supporting threats, shaded coverage, and defenses knowing the ball is going his way.
items.why: Elite efficiency/YPRR and production vs expected opportunity share post-coordinator change.
items.implication: Sustainable WR1 production even in tougher spots; hold/start confidently.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in yards per route run despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th in YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Excited for Declan Doyle scheme with healthy Lamar.
items.why: Elite YPRR efficiency even without Lamar; full unlock incoming.
items.implication: Flowers massive upside spike with Lamar return; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: YPRR leader + improved QB play and scheme.

items.text: Prefer to sell Chris Olave over Jordyn Tyson; rather sell the unproven rookie? No: give me Olave to sell, keep the upside rookie.
items.why: Olave more proven but prefers retaining unproven high-upside Tyson.
items.implication: Trade Olave if value high; hold breakout candidates.

items.text: Keeping it open on Sam LaPorta; could be in for a big day vs Vikings defense that will pressure Goff heavily.
items.why: Matchup vs pressure-heavy Vikes likely forces more TE targets.
items.implication: Strong TE start this week; keep rostered.
items.opportunity: Red-zone and volume upside in shootout potential.

items.text: Jadarian Price is BACK but question whether to put him right back into fantasy lineups.
items.why: Return from injury but prior benching and depth chart questions (Charbonnet/Wilson).
items.implication: Monitor role/snaps before auto-starting; stash/flex cautiously.
items.opportunity: Potential carries if earns back share.

items.text: Week 8 Waiver Wire analysis posted (FAAB, drops, injury report, streamers) by Daigle; Thorman Week 8 rankings live. Focus on injury-driven adds and pace/snaps.
items.why: Timely post-Week 7 injury and role shifts.
items.implication: Prioritize injury beneficiaries and returning players on waivers.

items.text: Lions full-PPR PPG dominance: Jahmyr Gibbs RB1 (clear of Walker), Amon-Ra St. Brown WR4 (behind only JSN/Puka/Lamb), Sam LaPorta TE6, Goff QB2, Jameson Williams WR24; no surprise given talent/schedule/defensive woes.
items.why: Concentration of talent and efficiency leading league positional scoring.
items.implication: Continue starting core Lions skill players aggressively ROS.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry shares in productive offense.
